name_zh: 西门子/德国/电气化/全球化/工业4.0/家族企业/技术报国
description_zh: 维尔纳·冯·西门子 (1816-1892) 德国电气工业奠基人，指针电报/发电机/电缆/电车开启电气化时代，西门子公司从柏林作坊发展为全球电气巨头，家族企业治理传承百年，技术报国理念贯穿两次大战与战后重建，工业4.0时代引领数字化制造转型。
description_en: Werner von Siemens (1816-1892) German electrical industry founder, pointer telegraph/generator/cable/tram inaugurated electrification age, Siemens from Berlin workshop grew into global electrical giant, family enterprise governance century-long inheritance, technology-for-nation ethos spanned two world wars and postwar reconstruction, Industry 4.0 era leading digital manufacturing transformation.
reason_zh: 西门子代表家族企业如何通过技术创新实现百年基业长青，展示了技术报国理念如何在战争/分裂/统一中保持连续性，其工业4.0转型为德国制造业数字化提供了标杆路径。
reason_en: Siemens represents how family enterprise achieves century-long longevity through technological innovation, demonstrating how technology-for-nation ethos maintains continuity through wars/division/reunification, its Industry 4.0 transformation providing benchmark path for German manufacturing digitalization.
steps_zh: 研究西门子早年炮兵/电报/指针电报发明/创业
分析1866印太电缆/1879发电机/1881电车/全球扩张
探讨两次大战/分裂/统一中的家族治理与技术传承
评估工业4.0/数字孪生/平台工业/思诺/西门子城
总结电气化/全球化/家族治理/技术报国/工业4.0五重遗产
steps_en: Study Siemens early artillery/telegraph/pointer telegraph invention/founding
Analyze 1866 Indo-Pacific cable/1879 generator/1881 tram/global expansion
Explore two wars/division/reunification family governance and tech inheritance
Summarize electrification/globalization/family governance/technology for nation/Industry 4.0 quintuple legacy
expected_zh: 掌握家族企业如何通过技术创新实现跨周期生存，理解技术报国如何在政治剧变中保持企业使命连续性，评估西门子工业4.0转型对德国制造业数字化的标杆示范。
expected_en: Master how family enterprise achieves cross-cycle survival through tech innovation, grasp technology-for-nation maintaining corporate mission continuity through political upheavals, evaluate Siemens Industry 4.0 transformation benchmark for German manufacturing digitalization.
case_zh: 1847 创立电报建筑公司；1866 印太电缆；1892 逝世；2011 工业4.0提出。电气化/全球化/家族/技术报国/工业4.0范式永存。
case_en: 1847 founded Telegraphen-Bauanstalt; 1866 Indo-Pacific cable; 1892 death; 2011 Industry 4.0 proposed. Electrification/globalization/family/tech for nation/Industry 4.0 paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: German Engineering / Industrial Entrepreneurship / Technology for Nation
cross_cultural_impact: Electrification; telegraph; generator; tram; Industry 4.0; family business longevity
